notes.title: GOLDEN DUCK for Flappy Souls!
notes.content:
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3228410/Flappy_Souls__Golden_Duck/] GOLDEN DUCK [/url] skin arrived! this is a DLC for if you want to support the game financially, it's a golden skin for the duck, it doesn't change anything in the gameplay in any way.

This is a game that I really enjoyed making, and it is very much a personal project, something that I wanted to exist even if it didn't provide financial returns, that's why the game is free. But if you still want to support the game and have a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3228410/Flappy_Souls__Golden_Duck/] golden duck [/url] skin, here's the option! And that's it, thanks everyone for playing!

notes.title: BIG UPDATE for Flappy Souls!
notes.content:
The new things: Now there are 2 difficulty modes. Now instead of collecting 3 souls, you can collect 120 swords + the golden version of each of them (it's a lot to collect). Now there are achievements, there are sound effects, quick transitions to better fluidity and other details!

So, I decided to remake the game, now it has a lot of new content! the original version was very simple and I was never very satisfied with it, I always had this desire to improve the game, and now I have done it, this remaking journey has been a lot of fun, thank you to everyone who played this game, and I hope you like this version!
